svg.data-what: an artery and a vein cut across side by side, with a capillary for comparison: the three coats of their walls

path.data-what: the tunica adventitia of the artery, the outer coat of connective tissue with its own tiny vessels

g.data-what: the tunica media of the artery, thick rings of smooth muscle and elastic sheets: it keeps the pressure and the pulse

path.data-what: the tunica intima of the artery: the endothelium lining the lumen, on its internal elastic lamina
the lumen of the artery, small and round, blood under high pressure
the tunica adventitia of the vein, its thickest coat

g.data-what: the tunica media of the vein, a thin layer of muscle: veins hold blood at low pressure

path.data-what: the tunica intima of the vein, its endothelial lining
the lumen of the vein, wide and often flattened

g.data-what: a valve of the vein, flaps of intima that stop blood from flowing back
a capillary, for comparison: one endothelial cell rolled into a tube just wide enough for a red cell; exchange happens here
